description:
## 1.36.0-dev.121 (2026-08-11)

- Reddit: continue from the previously selected native comment after scrolling instead of restarting at a boundary and looping through old comments.
- Reddit: hide the visual comment highlight while keyboard or touch scrolling moves content, then redraw it only on a real comment.
- Reddit: clear stale comment selection when leaving the post or when its Compose host detaches.
